data.action: 倚着阳台栏杆，晨风吹起银发与睡裙下摆
data.description: 【艾莉莎·九条 · 晨光阳台的凉风与银发】清晨的高层公寓阳台，晨风把晾着的衬衫吹得鼓起。艾莉莎只穿着那件大号睡衣倚在栏杆边，银发被风扬起，睡裙下摆轻轻翻飞。她眯起眼眺望晨光中的城市，回头时语气依然逞强——「……才不是特意早起等你。只是、只是阳台的风很舒服而已！」
data.lighting: soft golden morning light, gentle breeze, hazy city skyline glow
data.promptProse: She leans against the balcony railing and looks back from the hazy city skyline in golden morning light. The breeze lifts her hair and nightshirt hem while a shirt billows on the drying line behind her.
data.title: 艾莉莎·九条 · 晨光阳台的凉风与银发
data.animaCaption: The breeze lifts her hair and hem; a shirt billows on the clothesline behind her.
